memory: Ridge: 0.006 ± 0.001 mm crest at centroid coincides with strong tau_c jump and high-pressure spot at ≥0.091 mm. Correction: crest is necessary for the large discontinuity but not sole cause. Lateral shift +0.30 mm removed the localized pressure spike and reduced tau_c jump from ~0.016 to ~0.006 N·m; a smaller inflection remains. Micro-slip nucleation shifts laterally with centroid position. Current aim: disentangle geometric (ridge) contribution from secondary shear/subsurface effects by varying lateral offset magnitude and probing compliance.
openQuestion: If I increase lateral offset to 0.60 mm, does the residual tau_c inflection vanish or persist (and how does its amplitude scale)?
